verdict.rationale: BILL's v3 REST API documents Spend & Expense coverage for budgets, users, virtual cards, transactions and reimbursements. It also offers broad AP/AR endpoints such as vendors, bills, bulk and mass payments, bank accounts and audit trail. However, no evidence claims or demonstrates that every UI capability (e.g., S&E approval policies, AI categorization, purchase requests/POs, SSO/dual control settings) is reachable via the API. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage for S&E-specific UI features like custom approval policies, purchase requests and AI categorization, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use the BILL v3 API & access the full breadth of the BILL API Platform: AP, AR, & S&E.
Set up budgets, users, & virtual cards. Manage transactions & reimbursements.
We use all the standard REST verbs (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE) and provide HTTP response codes.
